title: Payment checks, eligibility and fraud data
shared: These studies follow the checks and data handoffs around public payments. Use them together to identify who supplies a signal, who may use it and who makes the program or payment decision.
keep_distinct: Keep screening matches, identity evidence, eligibility decisions, agency adverse action, MOU authority, actual data exchange, payment stops and proven fraud separate; sharing data does not merge agencies.

tools.title: The Fraud Detection Constitution
tools.why: Separate fraud-data instruments, screening signals and the agencies that make decisions.

tools.title: How Treasury checks a payment before the money leaves
tools.why: Follow Treasury payment screening and the decisions that remain with the originating agency.
